l'inverse.en: the other way around, the other way around

texto: **Contrairement à** + noun or pronoun (contrary to): **Contrairement à moi, tu aimes le sport** (unlike me, you like sport).
With verb **contrairement à ce que** + sentence: **Contrairement à ce que je pense** (unlike what I think) is used.

bloques.titulo: In the case of inverse, au contraire
texto: **À l'inverse** (reverse) and **au contraire** (on the contrary) change the idea: **Moi, au contraire, je déteste le sport** (I, on the other hand, hate sport).

filas: Contrairement à moi, tu aimes le sport.
À l'inverse, moi, j'adore le sport.
Moi, au contraire, je déteste le sport.

frases.fr: Contrairement à moi, tu aimes le sport.
frases.es: A diferencia de mí, a ti te gusta el deporte.

frases.fr: Bien au contraire, je déteste le sport.
frases.en: On the contrary, I hate sport.
analisis: on the contrary, on the contrary

frases.fr: À l'inverse, moi, j'adore le sport.
frases.es: Al revés, a mí me encanta el deporte.
frases.en: On the other hand, I love sport.
analisis: the other way around, the other way around

opciones.explicacion: «Contrairement à» expresses contrast or opposition to someone.
That would be expressed with «comme moi».
That would be expressed with «grâce à moi».

bloques.pregunta: Which one is right for «contrary to what I think»?

opciones.texto: Contrairement à ce que je pense.
opciones.explicacion: In front of a sentence with conjugated verb is used «contrairement à ce que».
The «à» preposition and the «ce» pronoun are missing.

opciones.texto: Contrairement de ce que je pense.
opciones.explicacion: The preposition required by «contrairement» is «à», never «de».

bloques.frase: Tu aimes le sport ; ___ moi, je le déteste.

opciones.explicacion: «Contrairement à» introduces the opposition to the «moi» pronoun.
«Loin de» rules infinitive or distance, not contrast between people.
«Malgré» expresses concession («despite the») and does not mark password opposition here.
Plural masculine adjective that matches «nous».
It means «close» and contradicts the expressed counterposition.
It is a singular («oposición») noun, incompatible with the preached.

bloques.frase: Contrairement à moi, tu aimes le sport.

opciones.explicacion: Contrast marked by «contrairement à».
It would express similarity («comme moi»).

opciones.texto: In spite of me, you like sport.
opciones.explicacion: Confusion of opposition with concession («malgré moi»).

bloques.audio: À l'inverse, moi, j'adore le sport.

opciones.texto: On the other hand, I love sport.
opciones.explicacion: «À l'inverse» places the position diametrically opposite.
A feeling of wrong similarity.
It combines «à l'inverse» with a temporary expression.

bloques.pregunta: What locution introduces an emphatic rebuttal to affirm the opposite of what was said?

opciones.explicacion: The emphatic locution that refutes a previous assertion by affirming the inverse.
It indicates analogy or similarity, not opposition.
Logical consequence connector, not counterposition.

intro: Now the contrast: when two people or things are opposite.
